title: Keely S
content: I felt myself reach out and touch a place of light, love, and deep relaxation. I felt an otherworldly presence tell me that my agony over being bisexual in a Christian household meant nothing at all because love was the ultimate purpose in life. I found such relief and such joy in experiencing a moment of communion with this presence. I knew then, with everything in my heart, that we are to love each other with everything in our bodies, that religion in the secular sense is practically silly. As long as I treat others with kindness, care, and understanding, all is fine. For a moment, I felt the web that connects every single person in life, and I was told we should treat each other with compassion, even if we don't understand each other. We are all unique parts of the universe experiencing itself. What a beautiful thing. When I regained consciousness, I felt a relief I had never known before.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Illness, Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I felt as though I was connected to the world in a way I had never known before.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Vision had no meaning because what I sensed and felt were things that have no comparison to normal life.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I felt these words more clearly than in real life, because in real life I have terrible hearing.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, I was part of the universe itself, one point in the web of humanity.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Relief and connection beyond what I had felt before.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I have freed myself from my strict Christian upbringing, and I have no regrets.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other faiths- Unitarian and other liberal faiths
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I felt religion itself does not matter, as long as we respect the world and strive to put more good and love into it. How we treat others is far more important than which god we worship, because every religion focuses on tiny aspects of what God truly is. How can any one religion claim to understand an infinite being?
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I mostly left my religion behind and I feel free now. I love God and the universe, but I no longer carry those burdens. It took me time to free myself from the weight of religion, but I haven't looked back.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It was as though I connected with God, or a being like a god, or perhaps the universal consciousness that is the universe itself.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, We are all part of the same universe, connected on a level I have yet to fully comprehend. Our kindness to each other is what truly matters, because while we are individuals, we are all part of this universe. The good we put into the world continues and makes the universe a better place. Love endures.
Uncertain, I don't know if the idea of universal kindness is new, but it's in the Bible and the only part that truly matters. God is made of love, and the universe is that love made manifest.
Yes, We will return to the universe itself, or perhaps continue in another life if we choose. There seemed to be options.
Yes, The chaos of the universe means bad things will happen, but it's our response to them that truly matters.

Yes, Every person's uniqueness should be loved. Our acts of unkindness can be forgiven, and even reluctance to forgive is understood. Love is the ultimate form of god, life, and what we should become. Everyone makes mistakes, but we are loved more than most will ever understand. God, or the universe, loves us with all its power, and we will feel that love when we depart. That knowledge still moves me deeply.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I used to be very strict in my religious life, but now I understand that religion itself is not what matters. What matters is compassion and love. I believe in trying to understand each other, even those we may not agree with or dislike. Can we put more good into the world? Pretending to care is just as bad as doing nothing if we do not act with love.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I try to be a kinder person to everyone. I want to spread as much love and good as possible and help as many people as I can. Even in tough times, doing your best means more than flourishing in good times.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I was so sick that I barely remember the events that happened that semester of college, but I remember this very well.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Being told that religious fixations, like gender, sexuality, or immigration, are silly and ridiculous freed me. I was weighed down by these concerns, and now I see them as meaningless. We are love. We are the universe given life and choice. We should explore this with wonder and love in our hearts. Life is a miracle. Every person is a wonder.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I knew that near-death experiences existed, but I did not realize how sick I was at the time. After recovering, I sought medical attention and realized how serious it might have been. Initially, I thought it was a special dream.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, At first I thought it was an important dream given to me by God. I am unsure how close I came to death, but I believe something critical happened after I recovered.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I know what I experienced was real. It was just a small glimpse of the universe's truth, given to me by God or the universe to guide me in the future.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain, I've tried weed since then, but even my heaviest trips cannot reproduce the sensation. Sometimes they feel almost like they can touch the tiniest fraction of it—that love and wonder.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Uncertain, It's such an intense, unique situation that I honestly have no idea what else you could ask.
